not_covered.supporting subdomain: The DDD booklet covers Core Domain and Generic Subdomains; 'supporting subdomain' does not appear.

not_covered.cqrs: Only mentioned in the DDD acknowledgments (p.4); no pattern is described.
not_covered.event sourcing: Only mentioned in the DDD acknowledgments (p.4); no pattern is described.
not_covered.microservices: They appear only in SREL p.1-2 (argument that they do not solve the SRP); there is no treatment of microservice architecture.
not_covered.microsservicos: They appear only in SREL p.1-2 (argument that they do not solve the SRP); there is no treatment of microservice architecture.
not_covered.hexagonal: Only MENTIONED: CA12 p.1 (Ports and Adapters) and DDD p.17. No detailed description.
not_covered.ports and adapters: Only MENTIONED: CA12 p.1. No detailed description.
not_covered.ator: The word 'ator' (actor) does NOT appear in the SRP post; it is from the book Clean Architecture (2017), outside the corpus.
